faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Things you might be wondering about the boutique store setup process.

delivery.question: How long does it take for a boutique e-commerce site to be ready?
delivery.answer: Depending on the project details and the number of products, it is usually launched within 3-6 weeks.

pricing.question: How is pricing determined?
pricing.answer: It is determined custom to you based on the store's design customizations, product volume, and requested extra integrations.

revisions.question: Do I have the right to revisions in design?
revisions.answer: Yes, we make the necessary revisions together during the design phase until you are completely satisfied.

maintenance.question: Can I manage products and stock myself?
maintenance.answer: Absolutely. We provide you with an extremely easy-to-use admin panel and offer training on how to use it.

migration.question: Can I migrate my existing store (Etsy, Shopier, etc.)?
migration.answer: Yes, we can seamlessly migrate your products and data from Etsy, Instagram, or other platforms to your new store.

mobile.question: Do you do Instagram Shop integration?
mobile.answer: Yes. We set up sales integrations that redirect directly to your store via Instagram and Facebook.
